concerns.text: The plan removes any motif that appears in the training or test splits from the curated fluorophore‑motif reference set ("Remove any motif that appears in training or test splits to guarantee independence"). Since the top‑20 substructures are derived from the test molecules themselves, this removal makes it impossible for any of those substructures to match the reference set, yet SC‑005 later requires ≥ 12 matches (≥ 60 %). This creates a circular/unsatisfiable validation: the independence step eliminates the very signals the validation expects to observe, rendering the attribution‑validation criterion empirically impossible.
